title.zh: 在卡林加-阿巴尧省Conner市镇设立区医院并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a District Hospital in the Municipality of Conner, Province of Kalinga-apayao, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a District Hospital in the Municipality of Conner, Province of Kalinga-apayao, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Bệnh viện Huyện tại Thị trấn Conner, Tỉnh Kalinga-apayao, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงพยาบาลอำเภอในเทศบาล Conner จังหวัด Kalinga-apayao และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Rumah Sakit Distrik di Kotamadya Conner, Provinsi Kalinga-apayao, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Hospital Daerah di Perbandaran Conner, Wilayah Kalinga-apayao, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7850_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Health, a district hospital in the Municipality of Conner, Province of Kalinga-Apayao, to be known as the Conner District Hospital.
The Secretary of Health shall issue the necessary rules and regulations for the effective implementation of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 24, 1994.
